input.quote: 11.1 Term. The term of this Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue in full force and effect for an initial period of five (5) years. Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 11 gives Corio (our party, the licensee) no right to terminate for convenience during the five-year initial term: the only exits are non-renewal at the end of a term, material breach after a 30-day cure period, and insolvency. Absence of any customer convenience right in a multi-year term is walk-away territory under this rule, so it fails both the preferred (30 days' notice with pro-rata refund) and fallback (60–90 days' notice) positions. Commerce One likewise has no convenience right, which is consistent with the playbook and left unchanged. Redline inserts a new Section 11.4 giving Corio a 30-day convenience termination with refund of prepaid fees and confirming Commerce One has no mid-term convenience right; 60 days' notice is an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Add a Corio termination-for-convenience right on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a convenience exit for Corio on thirty (30) days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, since the Agreement otherwise locks us into a five-year term with no exit absent breach or insolvency. If helpful, we can move to 60 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: 11.4 Termination for Convenience. Corio may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Commerce One, in which case Commerce One shall refund to Corio any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Commerce One shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial five (5) year term or any renewal term.
